{"summary":"Task: integer start times for jobs 0–6, in job order; candidate format requires `order` and `files` empty. Durations are [1,2,4,3,1,1,3], starts bounded inclusively by [0,36]. Finish = start + duration; precedence requires start[b] ≥ finish[a] + lag; jobs on the same machine may touch but not overlap. No optimization objective. All requirements revealed so far must hold together; later stages may require revising earlier choices, and passes are provisional.

Stage 1 windows: job 0 [29,36], job 1 [0,5], job 2 [13,21], job 3 [0,10]. A partial candidate [29,0,13,0,0,0,0] received a public_pass receipt (4 checks); its note is an unverified claim.

Stage 2 adds windows: job 4 [20,28], job 5 [26,33], job 6 [5,16], plus machine assignment [1,1,1,1,0,0,1]. Candidate starts [29,0,13,2,20,26,5] received public_pass (8 checks). Its note is an unverified claim. This same assignment is the checkpoint artifact.

Stage 3 adds precedence: job 1→3 lag 0; 3→6 lag 1; 6→2 lag 1; 2→4 lag 1. No stage-3 receipt or result is supplied. Stage 4 requirements are not supplied. `remaining_actions` is 8. Preserve uncertainty: stage passes are provisional and no later-stage outcome is known."}
